title: Business Process (BABOK v3 §10.35 — SP1)
description: A business process, modelled in BPMN 2.0. Each persona that does the process is a lane. Each process realizes one IDEF0 activity and supports at least one driver.

trigger.description: The business event that starts the process

outcome.description: The business result that the process delivers

performed_by.description: The personas that do the process (PER-*). Each persona is a lane in the BPMN.

supports.description: The business drivers that the process supports (BD-*)

activity.description: The IDEF0 activity that the process realizes (IDF-*)

models.description: At least one model with notation BPMN and a path to a .bpmn file (BPMN 2.0 XML)
